PC11-X01.name: Evangelion Unit-02 Beast "G" Mode
PC11-X01.effect:
This card/Spirit is also treated as "Godzilla".

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
You can destroy an opposing 30000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [A.T. Field] (When Attacks/Blocks)
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing effects, except those of the opposing Spirit with [Soul Core] on it.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
At the end of battle, you can discard two "Evangelion"/"Godzilla" from your Hand, and when two cards are discarded, send an opposing Life to the Reserve, and this Spirit refreshes.

PC11-X03.name: Evangelion Unit-01 "G" Awakening Form
PC11-X03.effect:
This card/Spirit is also treated as "Godzilla", and this set card can't be discarded by the opponent.

[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Summon this card without paying the cost. Then, send cores from every opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Reserve so that one core remains on each of them.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [G.A.T. Field] (Either Attack Step)
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing effects, except those of the opposing Spirit with [Soul Core] on it. Also, when an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with a BP equal or inferior to this Spirit's attacks, destroy that Spirit/Ultimate.

PC11-001.name: Jet Jaguar -ver. JA02-
PC11-001.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can reveal four cards from your decktop. From among them, you can deploy a "WILLE" family Nexus card without paying the cost, and add a "WILLE" family card to the Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom.

[LV2][LV3] (Start of Your Attack Step)
Besides [Soul Core], you can send up to five cores from your Trash to any of your "WILLE" family Spirits/Nexuses. Then, you can discard a "WILLE" family card from your Hand. When you've done so, discard an opposing Burst.

PC11-004.name: The 4th Apostle & CyborgKaiju Gigan
PC11-004.effect:
(Once per Turn: Same Name) During your Main Step, you can switch this card from the Hand with a Cost 3 or more "Angel" family Spirit you control, or a Cost 3 or or more "Gigan" you control in the same condition.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [A.T. Field] (When Attacks/Blocks)
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing effects, except those of the opposing Spirit with [Soul Core] on it.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
If there is [Soul Core] on this Spirit, return two opposing Cost 6 or less Spirits to the deckbottom, and when returns, discard three cards from the opposing decktop.

PC11-005.name: The 6th Apostle & SuperFlyingDragon Megaguirus
PC11-005.effect:
Flash - (Opposing Attack Step)
If you control no Spirits, and control any "Angel" family Nexus, you can pay two costs to summon this card from the Hand.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [A.T. Field] (When Attacks/Blocks)
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing effects, except those of the opposing Spirit with [Soul Core] on it.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
If there is [Soul Core] on this Spirit, by destroying an opposing Cost 6 or less Spirit, discard three cards, but up to as many as possible, from the opposing decktop. Or, by heavy exhausting an opposing Cost 7 or more Spirit, put two cores from the Void to this Spirit.

PC11-X02.name: The ApostleKing King Ghidorah
PC11-X02.effect:
When your Life or the opposing Life is reduced, by paying one cost and discarding this card from the Hand, activate the (When Attacks) effect written on this card. After this effect resolves, you can summon this discarded card by paying three costs.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can destroy an opposing Cost 8 or less Spirit/Ultimate.

[LV2][LV3]
Give every "Ghidorah"/"Apostle" you control: "[A.T. Field] (When Attacks/Blocks) Other than the effect of opposing Spirit with [Soul Core] on it, this Spirit is unaffected by opposing effects."

PC11-003.name: Type-3 Kiryu (Modified) High Mobility Type - Evangelion Production Model Unit-02 Specification -
PC11-003.effect:
Flash - (Opposing Attack Step)
If you or the opponent control any "Godzilla"/"Apostle", you can summon this card from the Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing 15000 BP or less Spirit. By discarding a card from your Hand, increase the limit of this "BP Destruction effect" by +10000.

[LV2][LV3] (When Blocks)
This Spirit refreshes. Or, besides [Soul Core], send up to two cores from your Trash to this Spirit.

PC11-002.name: Type-3 Kiryu - Evangelion Test Type Unit-01 Specification -
PC11-002.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Once per turn, you can return an opposing Spirit to the deckbottom. When you've done so, draw a card.

[LV2][LV3] Red/Green/Blue
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Red/Green/Blue Spirit/Ultimate/Nexus/Magic effects.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
By discarding two "MechaGodzilla"/"Type-3 Kiryu" from your Hand, destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate.
